status: synthetic; pressure units assumed Pa; uncalibrated

settings.common_absolute_threshold_basis: Zero-degree local peak * 10 ** (-dB / 20); supplemental peak-connected component, not exposure efficacy
settings.target_plane: F+u*t+y*v, target centered; 4 connectivity; own-local-peak thresholds; area=count*dt*dv; sample-border components truncated
settings.xz_contours: Scalar pressure threshold contours; include disconnected lobes, not selected focal component boundaries
settings.profile_sampling: linear interpolation, step <= min grid spacing / 4
settings.roi_boundary: within one voxel diagonal of ball edge, or physical/forward boundary
settings.caution: Forward maximum can be source/near-field dominated. No intensity, cure or safety inference.
